_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.75 improves native NI acquisition and measured diagnostics.

NI backlog draining retains every channel in mirrored native recordings while preserving acquisition timestamps and the existing display cadence. The loaded Qt repeat retained 56,090 samples without gaps: native p95/max 40/78 ms and GUI p95/max 92/253 ms. A first probe had an unexplained 10.9-second pause; that failure remains recorded.

Sinusoid diagnostics show measured amplitude, phase, error and actual actuator duty, and save traces even when identification is incomplete. Preparation now allows up to 60 seconds. The larger-cuff sweep completed but did not reproduce the full requested bandwidth: amplitude was 5.37 mmHg at 0.15 Hz and about 0.13 mmHg near 1.94 Hz for a requested 10 mmHg. Weak or noisy phase estimates are omitted.

Independent SysID comparison recomputes measurement gates and gains; it never copies tuning between cuffs. Native worker shutdown and pre-import process logs improve retention of stop, fault and exit evidence.

The branch's firmware and accepted calibration are unchanged. Pulse-preservation baseline testing awaits simulator pulses; real sharing awaits individual enrollment and a second PC. The current A-H identity scheme does not qualify a 1,000-device rollout. These are engineering measurements, not production or clinical certification.
